purpose: Establish one compact, machine-readable, unambiguous, verifiable and auditable communication grammar for terminal users, mesh instances, terminal boundaries, and pre/post-terminal architectural layers.
core_equation: MEANING = INTENT + BINDING + AUTHORITY + EVIDENCE + STATE + CAUSAL_ORDER + EFFECT + PROOF

understanding_rule.understood: A message is understood only when its syntax validates, all normative references are exact-bound, its authority is in scope, its evidence is attributable, its causal dependencies are preserved, and its effect semantics are not inferred beyond observed proof.

security_invariants: UNKNOWN is never promoted to TRUE.
No omitted field is interpreted as authorization.
action_required and zero-job terminality are not trusted success.
CAUSAL_ORDER is not SOURCE_ORDER or WALL_CLOCK_ORDER.
HOLD and NOOP do not imply failure.
A productive effect requires exact binding, applicable authority and admitted writer state.
Every productive effect requires post-effect reobservation before EFFECT_ACKNOWLEDGED.
The same semantic event retains the same deterministic event identity across inward and outward projections.
Compact text is a projection; canonical JSON is authoritative.

compact_form.fallback: If a value contains a reserved character, use canonical JSON only.

m68000_four_capsule_kernel.portability_rule: Preserve the four semantic outcomes and fail-closed behavior; opcode identity across target architectures is not required.
non_claims: No physical Motorola 68000 execution is asserted by this state file.
No reduction of arbitrary external productive effects to the v1 kernel is asserted.
No identical opcode encoding across modern processors is asserted.

continuous_improvement_contract.admission: A change is an improvement only when at least one objective is measurably improved and all must_preserve invariants remain verified.

contiguous_output_contract.rule: When a user requests one complete long-form result, generate and deliver the requested semantic object as one coherent final output instead of interleaving the content with avoidable partial-delivery stops.

forced_continuation.resume_rule: Continue at the first undelivered semantic boundary without normalization or silent omission.

non_claims: This contract does not enlarge model context, token, transport or runtime limits.
This contract does not authorize omission of safety, authority, evidence or claim boundaries.
This contract does not make an unverified candidate canonical.
